newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Leading Spirit down after placement.
newsitem.headline: Leading Spirit down after placement.

text.p: Shares of Leading Spirit (Holdings) Co Ltd, which resumed trading after a one-day suspension, fell on dilution fears after the company announced a HK$570 million share placement, brokers said on Wednesday.
"People unloaded their holding on fear of dilution after the placement," said a sales manager at a regional brokerage.
The company's shares, which were among the most heavily traded stock by turnover, fell HK$0.145 or 6.99 percent to HK$1.93 at midday on volume of 356.34 million shares.
Leading Spirit said it planned to issue 300 million new shares to its chairman and controlling shareholder Wong Shi Ling at HK$1.95 each, raising net proceeds of HK$570 million.
It said Wong had also agreed to place the same number of existing shares to private investors at the same price.
On completion of the deal, Wong's stake in the consumer electronic and electrical products maker will be diluted to 59.08 percent from 66.42 percent.
